spec_match.rationale: Implements §10.5's actual definition — identical primaries/white point to display-p3, transfer function unity — with the exact piecewise sRGB curve, and validates against the spec's own example pair (0.591 0.123 0.264 ↔ 0.3081 0.014 0.0567).

interactive.rationale: Live matchMedia color-gamut readouts with change listeners, painted swatch rows with computed-value readouts, a bidirectional six-input converter, and a spec-example preset button that self-checks the math.

blurb_alignment.rationale: The index card promises the gamut media probe, out-of-gamut reds and a coordinate converter with visible transfer-function math; all three are on the page.

edge_cases.rationale: Handles the unsupported display-p3-linear patch with an explicit labelled state, the sRGB-display case (media probe explains why the reds may look identical), the 1.0-is-a-fixed-point subtlety, and sign-mirroring for negative components in the converter.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus.com/feature/5162372125818880, spec §10.5 and the color-gamut media feature.

conformance.rationale: Feature suite covers the color() grammar and own-space computed serialization this page relies on; the media-query state is page-level live evidence rather than a suite assertion, correctly, since it measures the display not the browser.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141: color-gamut probe honestly reports srgb-only, both live reds painted with computed values shown, converter DOM output 0.30814 0.01397 0.05666 matching the spec example, console clean; a P3 display and a 144+ build were both unavailable, and the swatch-identity check is explicitly labelled manual observation.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts gamut-probe (with per-gamut booleans), reds-rendered (recording the p3-linear branch) and transfer-matches-spec-example, so both math correctness and branch selection are visible in production telemetry.

design_system.rationale: All chrome on CSS variables with the button colour override; the red patches and converter swatches are the values under test and exempt; the unsupported patch is a labelled hatched panel, never a fake color.

accessibility.rationale: Native number inputs with visible labels in fieldsets/legends, aria-live converter and gamut outputs, role=img patches with computed-value text equivalents beside them; partial pending accessibility-tree inspection with chrome-devtools-mcp.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Verified at a true 360px CSS viewport and 1280px: fieldsets stack via auto-fit grid, gamut list rows wrap, no horizontal overflow, 44px inputs and buttons.

openQuestions.title: Capture evidence on a real P3 display
openQuestions.detail: The color-gamut probe correctly reports srgb in this headless environment, so the visible difference between sRGB red and P3 red could not be photographed. A session on P3 hardware should confirm (color-gamut: p3) matches and the patches visibly diverge, and record it here.

openQuestions.title: Extend the converter beyond [0,1] once HDR context exists
openQuestions.detail: ChromeStatus names HDR as the adoption path; linear-light values above 1.0 are where that goes. The converter clamps inputs to [0,1] today, matching the SDR spec table (white luminance 80 cd/m²). When the PredefinedColorSpace/canvas follow-up ships, an extended-range mode with out-of-range handling would be a good additive angle.

openQuestions.title: Verify the swatch-identity pair on Chrome 144+
openQuestions.detail: When display-p3-linear is supported, the converter paints both encodings side by side and they should be indistinguishable. This branch needs a 144+ build to verify, then the manual-observation note can carry recorded evidence.

guidanceConsulted.query: wide gamut CSS colors and gamut fallbacks
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Gate wide-gamut presentation on real capability signals (color-gamut media feature) and provide honest fallbacks.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The page's central probe is live matchMedia('(color-gamut: …)') with change listeners, and its verdict text tells visitors exactly what their display can and cannot show before they interpret the swatches.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible before after visual comparison sliders text equivalents
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Never rely on a perceivable color difference alone; pair visual comparisons with numeric/text state and label editable groups with fieldset/legend.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Every patch carries its declaration and computed serialization as text, the converter uses two legend-labelled fieldsets with per-channel labels, and results announce through aria-live outputs.

summary: The hardware-and-math page: a genuinely live color-gamut media probe (honestly srgb-only in the build environment), out-of-gamut reds with computed-value proof that P3 declarations stay in their own space, and a spec-validated transfer-function converter whose output matches §10.5's example to five decimals. Follow-ups need P3 hardware and a 144+ build.
